what_it_does: Describes BitMoD, a co-design (algorithm plus hardware working together) for accelerating large language models using mixed-precision arithmetic. Large models require huge amounts of memory for weights. BitMoD lets different parts of the model use different numerical formats—some parts INT4 (4-bit integers), others FP4 (4-bit floating-point), others NF4 (normalized 4-bit floats)—adapted per group of 128 weights to minimize accuracy loss. Hardware implements this by using bit-serial processing (examining one bit at a time), which natively handles multiple formats within a single design with a unified internal representation.
